zh: 反转数位不需要字符串：x 对 10 取余得到最低位，x 整除 10 去掉最低位。
先记下符号，对绝对值做反转，再把符号乘回去；原数末尾的 0 反转后变成前导零，自然消失。
循环执行“答案乘 10 加上当前最低位，x 整除 10”，直到 x 为 0。最后检查结果是否在 −2^31 到 2^31−1 之间，不在就输出 0。中间结果用 64 位整数保存，才能安全判断越界（−2^31 的绝对值本身就超出 32 位）。
en: Reversing digits needs no string: x modulo 10 gives the lowest digit and integer division by 10 removes it.
Remember the sign, reverse the absolute value, then apply the sign again; trailing zeros of the input become leading zeros and simply disappear.

Repeat "answer times 10 plus the lowest digit, then divide x by 10" until x is 0. Finally check that the result lies in −2^31 to 2^31−1 and print 0 otherwise. Keep the intermediate value in a 64-bit integer so the overflow check is safe; the absolute value of −2^31 already exceeds 32 bits.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Repeatedly take the units digit and append it to the end of the answer, without using string operations.

## Overflow

The rule from the official statement of the same problem says to output 0 when the reversed result is outside the signed 32-bit range.

## Correctness

Each step appends the lowest digit of the original number to the current answer, so after all digits are processed the answer is exactly the reversed number; overflow is then handled by the range rule.

## Complexity

Time O(log|x|), space O(1).
